originalTitle: Alan Jones trial live updates: former radio broadcaster in Sydney court for day two of indecent assault case – latest news
summary: Former 2UE and 2GB radio broadcaster is facing 22 charges. Jones, 85, has pleaded not guilty
content: Complainant J has told the court that a “tactic” he’d use to try and avoid Alan Jones’s alleged assaults was to bring up the girlfriend he had at the time. J said he used this tactic during the alleged assault at the Fitzroy Falls property. He told the court: I already mentioned to him that I’d never done anything like that with a man. I thought if I brought up my girlfriend it would help. A reminder of our warning that this live blog may contain graphic content when discussing evidence in the trial. Complainant J has alleged that after he and Alan Jones finished dinner at Jones’s Fitzroy Falls property, Jones told him “to go and have a shower and come out wearing a robe and nothing else”. Prosecutor Georgina Wright asked: Did you do it? J, who was a teenager at the time of the alleged incident, responded: No, I put my underpants on and then I put the robe on and went out. The defendant was in a room with a grand piano, the court heard. Wright said: “Why did you put the underpants on?” J told the court: “I almost knew what was going to happen … he’s going to touch me.” J alleged Jones was sitting on the lounge, also in a robe and was drinking a glass of wine. J alleged that Jones “looked me straight in the eye” and said in a “quiet”, “calm” and “sympathising tone”: “I said the robe and nothing.” J alleged in court that Jones then “put his hand back on my penis and started rubbing it”. Complainant J begins today’s evidence via video link Complainant J has begun his evidence again today, appearing via video link. The prosecutor, Georgina Wright, is clarifying evidence about an incident detailed by J yesterday. J alleged that one of the indecent assaults occurred while he was driving Jones to his Fitzroy Falls farm. J alleged that Jones grabbed his penis over his pants and then under his underpants. He also alleged that, when he got out of the car, Jones kissed him without his consent. J told the court this morning: It was always a kiss or an action first. Then I’d be asked if ‘this is OK, are you comfortable with that?’ However, he said that did not occur during this particular alleged incident. There was no follow-up. It was straight into ‘let’s go look at the house and the property’. On some occasions there was a cuddle beforehand or an indicator to make me believe a kiss was coming. But on that occasion he gave me a kiss much quicker than I expected. Alan Jones has arrived in the courtroom. The proceedings are expected to kick off again in a moment. On day one of the trial, the court heard several of the nine alleged indecent assaults against complainant J. In case you missed our live coverage yesterday, below is a wrap of what was alleged in the first day of J’s evidence in chief. Once J’s evidence in chief on each of the nine allegations is complete, he will be cross-examined by Alan Jones’s legal team. Alan Jones first met complainant J when he was 14 years old and a star school athlete and “praised” him about his sports ability. J alleged that Jones made a weekly deposit of $400 a week into his bank account and told him he didn’t have to tell anyone because it was a gift. J, who was a teenager at the time, alleged that he was asked to drive Jones to a function in Canberra, and while the pair were alone in the hotel room Jones allegedly kissed him in a “smothering” way. J alleged that after the Canberra incident Jones told him he had “been a really good boy” and increased his weekly stipend. J told the court he didn’t tell his coach about an alleged incident because he “felt I’d lose everything” and said that he had “come from a small family” and “was getting everything handed” to him and it was a “wonderful life”. J alleged that one of the indecent assault incidents occurred while he was driving Jones to his Fitzroy Falls farm and Jones grabbed his penis over his pants and then under his underpants. The trial is expected to resume at 10am with complainant J continuing his evidence. I’m in court now with Amanda Meade to follow all the developments on day two. If you want a summary of what happened yesterday, you can read Ben Doherty’s analysis below: The booming voice, the vast radio audience, the bully pulpit of an eponymous TV show, the great and the good on speed-dial, a staffer in the prime ministerial office dubbed the ‘minister for Alan Jones’: these were not ancillaries peripheral to the Jones empire, they were central to it. Even walking into court on Monday, at the centre of a glacially moving press pack, it was all about Alan. That evaporated as soon as he stepped inside the claustrophobic confines of court 3.1. Here he is simply ‘the defendant’. Welcome to day two of the Alan Jones indecent assault trial On Monday, a former schoolboy athlete told the court he didn’t tell anyone that the broadcaster, now 85, was allegedly kissing him and touching his genitalia when he was a teenager because he was “fearful” of losing Jones’s financial support. The man, known as complainant J, is expected to continue giving evidence via video link on Tuesday. J is the first of six complainants expected to give evidence of their alleged indecent assault by Jones, who is facing 22 charges. The trial before judge Glenn Walsh at Downing Centre local court is expected to run for four months and hear from 76 witnesses. Jones has denied all wrongdoing and said the allegations are either baseless or distorted the truth. Jones’s defence barrister Gabrielle Bashir SC on Monday argued that the alleged victims had been egged on to complain by media rivals – and their reliability and credibility were questionable. I’m Jordyn Beazley and I’ll be keeping you up to date throughout the day alongside my colleague Amanda Meade.
chineseTitle: 艾伦·琼斯审判现场更新：前广播电台在悉尼法院审理非礼案第二天 – 最新消息
chineseSummary: 前 2UE 和 2GB 无线电广播公司面临 22 项指控。 85 岁的琼斯不认罪
chineseContent: 原告 J 告诉法庭，他用来避免艾伦·琼斯涉嫌性侵的“策略”是提起他当时的女朋友。 J 说，他在菲茨罗伊瀑布房产被指控的袭击事件中使用了这一策略。他告诉法庭：我已经向他提到我从来没有对一个男人做过这样的事情。我想如果我提起我的女朋友会有帮助。提醒您注意我们的警告，即在讨论审判中的证据时，此实时博客可能包含图形内容。投诉人 J 声称，他和艾伦·琼斯在琼斯的菲茨罗伊瀑布住所吃完晚饭后，琼斯告诉他“去洗个澡，然后只穿长袍就出来”。检察官乔治娜·赖特问道：是你干的吗？据称事件发生时，J 正处于青少年时期，他回答说：不，我穿上内裤，然后穿上长袍就出去了。法庭获悉，被告所在的房间里有一架三角钢琴。赖特说：“你为什么穿上内裤？” J 告诉法庭：“我几乎知道会发生什么……他会碰我。” J 声称琼斯坐在休息室里，也穿着长袍，正在喝一杯酒。 J声称琼斯“直视着我的眼睛”，并以“安静”、“平静”和“同情的语气”说道：“我说的是长袍，什么也没说。” J 在法庭上声称，琼斯随后“把手放回到我的阴茎上并开始摩擦它”。投诉人 J 今天通过视频链接开始作证 投诉人 J 今天再次通过视频链接开始作证。检察官乔治娜·赖特 (Georgina Wright) 正在澄清 J 昨天详述的事件的证据。 J 声称，其中一起非礼袭击事件发生在他开车送琼斯前往他的菲茨罗伊瀑布农场时。 J声称琼斯抓住了他的阴茎并遮住了他的裤子
